uncertain: J7, J10, J4 and J5 have no label beside each individual pad; names come from a nearby silkscreen text box (e.g. 'IO38 IO37 3V3 GND' next to J7, '3V3 3V3 GND GND IO18-RX1 IO17-TX1 IO38 IO37' next to J4, 'VON- VOP+' next to J5). The pad-to-name mapping assumes the box lines run left-to-right in the same order as the pads; the image does not mark this explicitly.
Board identity: the PCB silkscreen reads 'ESP32 Display-4.3 Inch SKU:DIS06043H V2.0' (Elecrow); the record name 'CrowPanel ESP32 HMI 4.3-inch Display' is not printed in the image.
notes: Rear PCB render. Printed names like 'IO18-RX1' are split into label IO18 with RX1 in functions (rule 5). The 'O' in IO names is an unslashed letter, distinct from the slashed zero used elsewhere on this silkscreen (J10, Q10). Battery connector J1 included because its pins are marked - and +. Skipped: USB-C J3 (UART0), display FPC JP1 and TF card slot (pins not individually labeled), BOOT/RESET buttons, LEDs, and the text boxes 'IO0_TP_CS...' and 'I2S-CTRL...' which are not beside any connector.
